editorial.name: Amigo AI
editorial.descriptionZh: 面向医疗机构的临床 AI agent 平台，用一批虚拟病人做训练和评估，覆盖初诊、随访、用药管理这些流程，官网把 SOC 2 Type II、HIPAA 等合规状态逐条标出。
editorial.takeawayZh: 看它怎么用虚拟病人流程讲临床 agent 训练
editorial.noteZh: 首屏白底，最顶一条细通告写 New Dr. Jay Shah Joins Amigo as CMO，导航 Platform / Solutions / Specialties / Customers / Guides / Insights / Company 加右上深红 Book a Demo。主标题是衬线大字 Every clinical workflow on one unified data foundation.，左边一小段竖线引文写 Make your care team feel 10x bigger while meeting the safety and reliability standards of healthcare.，下面深红 Book a Demo 按钮。主视觉右边是一块深色视频区，截帧里是一张模糊的人脸特写。往下是 TRUSTED BY HEALTHCARE LEADERS WORLDWIDE 和三个数字 10M+ Patients reached worldwide、24x Return on investment、100% Safety record；再往下 Security for critical operations. 段把 SOC 2 Type II、HIPAA、PIPEDA & PHIPA、GDPR、HITRUST e1、ISO/IEC 27001、ISO/IEC 42001 逐条标出完成或进行中，Specialties 段轮播 Primary Care、Digital Health、Orthopedic、Women's Health、Behavioral Health、Cancer Care 六个专科，最后是 The Amigo Digital Residency 段的 01 VIRTUAL PATIENTS / 02 SIMULATED CONVERSATIONS / 03 SUPERVISED EVALUATIONS。
editorial.pricing: unknown - 首页无价格，入口是 Book a Demo

reasons.statement: 首页交付的是 Amigo 这个医疗 AI 产品的平台说明、合规清单与专科方案，用户拿走的是 B2B 医疗首页的结构与信任区写法，不是可下载的素材或代码。
站内路径是 /platform、/specialties/*、/solutions/*、/customers/*、/security 这类自家产品与案例页，形态是产品官网。
